column8: KEEP. Q1's bimodal rule reaches this row only if it can name the magnitude, and it cannot: the channel declares judging(code-smell.parameter-count) (ConstructorOverinjectionRule.php:68) and so does code-smell.long-parameter-list (LongParameterListRule.php:81), and two channels cannot both be spelled code-smell.parameter-count. The overlap the enumeration measured stands and is NOT closed by this table: LongParameterListRule does not exclude __construct (LongParameterListRule.php:115-117), so one 8-parameter non-VO constructor raises BOTH code-smell.constructor-overinjection (default threshold 8) and code-smell.long-parameter-list (default 6) on the same declaration. That is a question about BEHAVIOUR — intended layering or duplicate reporting — and the ADR of P3 deliberately does not settle it by choosing a name. Renaming either channel would encode an answer the owner has not given, at the cost of a silent-class rename; keeping both names leaves the behaviour question exactly as visible as it is now. The name itself is accurate about what the reader is told: too many injected constructor dependencies.
